name: abusive traffic
description: Parses apache log files to identify IP addresses that are hammering your site and you want to ban.
project_description: The abusive traffic module helps identify abusive traffic (spam users / bots) by IP address on Acquia Cloud Next hosting. It leverages the Acquia Cloud API (v2) via Drush commands to generate an Apache access log for the last hour, download and parse it, count hits per client IP, and email a configured list of recipients when any single IP crosses a configurable threshold. Recipients then review the flagged IPs and block them via the core Ban module or (recommended) a .htaccess rule. Optionally the downloaded log files can be forwarded over SFTP to a service such as Splunk for further parsing. Requires an Acquia Cloud API token plus application UUID stored in Acquia secrets, and the phpseclib library for SFTP. Configuration (threshold, IP ignore list, alert email list, SFTP forwarding toggle) lives at /admin/config/system/abusive-traffic. Maintained by Nate Millin.
